title: Iris Ventures Founder Montse Suarez Says There’s a Long Highway Ahead for Wellness
summary: Suarez talks about her investment philosophy, and where she sees new opportunity in a sector that's set to generate $9 trillion by 2028, according to the Global Wellness Institute.
